messages:
Leah (People Ops): Hey team — compiling a lightweight onboarding kit for new managers joining Redwood. Draft below. pls add gaps, owners, or quick edits. Aim: a concise first-week agenda + 30/60/90 template + who-to-ask cheat sheet.

Leah (People Ops): DRAFT CHECKLIST (short):
• Day 0: IT account + laptop + VPN + KMS access (IT owner: @it-ops)
• Day 1 AM: meet your manager + team intro (30m)
• Day 1 PM: infra demo — end-to-end inference request walkthrough (45m)
• Week 1: shadow 1:1s with peers, ops readouts, and ticket triage (owners: manager + buddy)
• Week 2: run first retro with team, finalize 30/60/90 goals
• 30/60/90: simple measurable goals (see template below)
• Who-to-ask: infra, security, billing, product, legal + people-ops contact list (link)
• Compliance: required trainings to complete by end of week 2 (HR)

Priya (Recruiting): Love it. One ask — add a quick note on people-ops expectations for manager check-ins (weekly 1:1s with reports, skip-levels at month 1). Also add a short blurb about manager onboarding interview feedback loop.

Samir (Eng Manager): Add: schedule a 60-min runtime walkthrough with eng-runtime (we'll show how KV cache & batching affect latency). Also please include an ops runbook pointer for paging oncall: `#eng-oncall` and `pagerduty` playbook link.

Jordan (Product): For 30/60/90 template — suggest product-aligned goals + signal metrics. Example quick template:
• 30-day: ship onboarding doc + meet cross-functional partners + baseline metric (e.g., 99th pct latency)
• 60-day: lead one small rollout or experiment + reduce token cost by X% via batch config
• 90-day: own a rollout plan for model variant with rollback criteria and SLA targets

Ava (HR): Reminder — new managers need to sign the data access addendum before we grant private deployment keys. I'll drop the onboarding checklist with deadlines into the new hire packet. Also we require compliance courses: Security 101, Data Handling, and Code of Conduct.

Maddie (Onboarding Buddy): Happy to be buddy for any new manager. I can run the first-week shadow sessions and intro demos. Ping me to set up the calendar blocks — I usually block AMs for deep dives. :wave:

onboard-bot: New hire buddy assigned: Maddie. Calendar invites sent for "Intro to Runtime" and "Team Standup".

Leah (People Ops): Thanks all. I'm going to: (1) add the runtime walkthrough and `#eng-oncall` links, (2) surface the compliance deadlines, and (3) add Priya's 1:1 expectations. Will update the doc and tag owners. Anything else missing?

Samir (Eng Manager): One more: add a short troubleshooting snippet they can paste when opening infra tickets: ```
Subject: New manager infra access issue - <name>
Steps tried: VPN, laptop restart, kube-auth refresh
Attached: screenshot, error logs
Priority: P2
```

Priya (Recruiting): Maybe include a tiny checklist for first-week meetings to schedule (HR intro, Security, Eng-runtime, Product, Buddy, Finance). Keeps calendars from scattering.

Leah (People Ops): Great — will add that and mark owners. I'll ping again when the doc is live. Thanks :thumbsup:

Jordan (Product): :thumbsup: This is great — short and actionable, exactly what new managers need.

Ava (HR): I'll follow up with the compliance doc link and due dates.

Maddie (Onboarding Buddy): Happy to review the final doc before it goes live.

Leah (People Ops): noted — final step: quick review with Maddie + Priya, then publish. target EOD Fri.
